'''2004 German Open (Ralltiir) Dirk Friedrichs LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2004 German Open (Ralltiir)]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Dirk "Uber-Obi" Friedrichs (2005-03-30).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34634 Uber-Obi helps Padmes Plan]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050923181418/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34634 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Multi-event deck used over two years; posted Mar 2005, so the list may be the 2005 version rather than the 2004 German Open list.<ref name="src" />

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Friedrichs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2004 German Open (Ralltiir)]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
